subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer the selected channel's single enabled/configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw keep requiring explicit/default account selection when the default account is disabled?
rationale: The requested behavior fixes a real message-loss footgun but changes documented default-account fallback semantics for existing multi-account setups, so maintainer policy acceptance is needed before landing the linked PR.

options.title: Accept Shared Resolver Policy
options.body: Land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep Explicit Account Selection
options.body: Keep current default-account semantics and document that users must set `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Move Fallback To Channel Ownership
options.body: Require channel-owned inference rules if maintainers do not want core to define this fallback policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Resolver Policy
recommendation.body: Land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the concrete shared-resolver direction and has the strongest current history around the affected account-selection policy.
